description: This script measures interrupt latency and system load effects using cyclictest and stress-ng, including functions for stress management, cyclictest execution, and result analysis.

classes.name: cyclictest_runner
classes.description: Class encapsulating the cyclictest execution and result reporting logic.

methods.name: tc_name
methods.description: Generates a test case name based on a sub-name.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with '#' prefix to ignore in TEFEL.

methods.name: log_test_header
methods.description: Logs header information for a test case.

methods.name: start_stress
methods.description: Starts stress-ng with specified stress types.

methods.name: set_hung_tmo
methods.description: Sets hung task timeout value in Linux kernel.

methods.name: gen_minmax_list
methods.description: Generates a list of minimums from max list via pairwise max reduction.

methods.name: run_cyclictest_once
methods.description: Runs cyclictest once and parses output for min, avg, max.

methods.name: run_cyclictest_suite
methods.description: Runs multiple cyclictest iterations, tracks min, max, and average latencies.
